assumption: Procurement Package should be the structural root of all procurement/commercial activity.
load_bearing_reason: Determines parent-child graph for requisitions tenders bids commitments and reporting.
falsification_test: Primary evidence shows material/repeat/call-off procurement is common and naturally independent of packages.
notes: Must be tested against both package-led and item/requisition-led contractors.

assumption: Purchase Order and Subcontract require distinct top-level entity types.
load_bearing_reason: Affects duplicated workflow changes compliance reporting and payment models.
falsification_test: A unified Commitment entity with valuation strategy cleanly represents both without semantic leakage.

assumption: The product should own invoice/payment commercial controls while accounting GL/AP may remain external.
load_bearing_reason: Defines highest-risk system-of-record seam and payment/retention authority.
falsification_test: Beachhead workflow requires accounting platform to remain authoritative for certification/balances making product ownership duplicative.

assumption: Deep ERP/accounting integration is mandatory for V1.
load_bearing_reason: Could make at least one connector a SPINE requirement and materially expand build/implementation burden.
falsification_test: Beachhead customers can operate viable procurement/commercial workflow with import/export or lightweight reconciliation first.

assumption: Long-lead control should use an independent TrackedItem entity.
load_bearing_reason: Controls cardinality between package commitment lines submittals shipments and deliveries.
falsification_test: Real cases fit more naturally as milestone instances attached to existing commercial/material objects.

assumption: A fully general workflow/approval engine belongs in V1.
load_bearing_reason: Potential multi-month platform subsystem and large testing/configuration burden.
falsification_test: Beachhead workflows can be covered by a constrained rule set such as sequential parallel value-threshold and delegation.

assumption: Broad configuration and custom-field capability should exist in V1.
load_bearing_reason: Configuration multiplies build onboarding support and migration complexity.
falsification_test: Implementation-burden budget is violated and fixed standards cover most beachhead variance.

assumption: GCC requirements are mostly a late localization concern.
load_bearing_reason: Tax timing retention guarantees payment practices and FIDIC-derived structures may shape the core ledger/schema.
falsification_test: Primary GCC workflows show these affect core transaction/financial semantics.
notes: Presentation language/date formatting remains late; commercial semantics do not.

assumption: Budget/cost-code structure must exist before procurement begins.
load_bearing_reason: May force all sourcing/commitment objects to require prior financial attribution and affects rapid/ad-hoc purchasing.
falsification_test: Real workflows show valid procurement begins before budget/cost coding and is allocated later under controlled rules.

assumption: Vendor participation must be low-friction and heavyweight portal accounts materially reduce response/adoption.
load_bearing_reason: Affects external identity tender submission communications and vendor UX architecture.
falsification_test: Primary evidence shows vendors routinely use authenticated portals without meaningful response loss in beachhead segment.

assumption: Parallel human-maintained procurement trackers are a major failure mode and statuses should derive from transaction events where possible.
load_bearing_reason: Supports event-derived schedule/status architecture and limits duplicate manual fields.
falsification_test: Primary workflows show separate trackers remain necessary for information not representable by transaction state or are preferred for legitimate reasons.

assumption: Document provenance is a core commercial architecture requirement.
load_bearing_reason: Shapes document/evidence model and AI provenance constraint.
falsification_test: Beachhead workflows and disputes do not materially depend on versioned source evidence or external CDE can fully own this responsibility.
notes: REQ-0001 remains proposed until evidence/ADR acceptance.

assumption: Financial/commercial objects require explicit posting/finalization and reversal semantics.
load_bearing_reason: Shapes ledger state machines audit and accounting reconciliation.
falsification_test: A simpler immutable-version model covers all beachhead financial corrections without posting concepts.
notes: Likely but still to be formally designed.

assumption: External-party UX is as important as internal employee UX for product adoption.
load_bearing_reason: Could justify guest/magic-link workflows email ingestion and reduced portal friction.
falsification_test: Beachhead contractors have enough leverage/process discipline that supplier portal friction does not materially affect response/completeness.

assumption: AI competition requires agent-ready deterministic architecture from inception.
load_bearing_reason: Justifies bounded actions/provenance constraints before AI work.
falsification_test: Agent-readiness constraints materially inflate deterministic product without realistic future value or can be added later without rearchitecture.
notes: Only low-cost irreversible constraints may be adopted early.
